query.query_text: Q_module_body_v1: unit = module body = the maximal set of Calls whose recorded owning module path (correspondence: nn_module_stack-derived) is identical; a non-leaf module's own Calls are their own body; Calls with no module are the root body; boundary values = U_V (in(V) u out(V)) over these units (verity.verification.query.boundary_values) minus the Program's literals (the Values of Calls that read no Value: written in the descriptor, never acquired); policy: prescribed = record-typed inputs (weights); protocol = sampling-event outputs + recorded return slots + returned tensors (every Value of an fx node's output at a step once any of them crosses the body boundary); hidden = fa2_hidden_m1_stream; profile = ampere

policy.prescribed_inputs: every field of the Program's record-typed parameters
protocol_required: returned tensors: all rows / ports of an fx node's output once one crosses (TENSOR-RETURN)

named_residuals.why: vLLM `LinearBase.forward` returns `(output, output_bias)`; the collector binds slot 0.  The Program's Definition returns one array (`out`) and the Build recorded no return slot for the row -- the tuple slot is Python's, invisible to the Program

vLLM `LinearBase.forward` returns `(output, output_bias)`; the collector binds slot 0.  The Program's Definition returns one array (`out`) and the Build recorded no return slot for the row -- the tuple slot is Python's, invisible to the Program (blockwise-FP8 linear)

vLLM `LinearBase.forward` returns `(output, output_bias)`; the collector binds slot 0.  The Program's Definition returns one array (`out`) and the Build recorded no return slot for the row -- the tuple slot is Python's, invisible to the Program (the row-parallel linear returns the all-reduced tensor as slot 0: an all-reduce of any world takes the slot of its rank-local operand when that operand is a Linear's reading its own weight)
the Build records RoPE's return slots by keyword (`query` / `key`); v1 spells them as the tuple index of `RotaryEmbedding.forward -> (q, k)`.  Same slot, two spellings
v1 encodes the token ids a module consumes as `<consuming module>/in` (family input_token_ids): the Value is the prompt input or the previous step's sampled id, spelt at its consumer
v1 encodes the sampling event's output under the fixed path `runner.sampler` (the root body has no module path)
v1 encodes a registered weight as `<field path>/weight` with an open range, once per rank
the attention M1 stream is a kernel-side stream under `fa2.m1/L<k>` (k = the attention body's ordinal); its member is the launch geometry (v1 `_fa2_geometry` / `_fa3_geometry`)

TP-04: a collective's rank-local operand (the one Value of this rank it reads; its other operands are the received peer partials) is required per rank beside the collective's output, under the collective's module, as `part_rank<r>` (all-reduce) / `shard_rank<r>` (all-gather), family `tp_rank_partials`

a collective whose rank-local operand another module produced is a collective SITE of the module whose forward calls it, at the site path `<enclosing module>.<fx node>`: the collector hooks the enclosing module and commits its k-th collective of the step as occurrence k, so the site's identities live at (enclosing module, k) -- k in Program order, from 1 when the enclosing module has required Values of its own -- and the site path is an `op_path_aliases` entry

schedule.basis: engine schedule of record: per-committed-step request rows (the scheduler's row order as the collector recorded it); arrival = the first committed step the request ran in

coverage.engine_step_basis: engine schedule of record (request step + observed arrival)

not_executed_by_rule.rule: executed_prefix_len = cap when served_output_len == cap (length stop); served_output_len + LAG when the request stopped by EOS before its cap (the last served token must be a declared EOS id, F-pm-24, and it must be the FIRST EOS served -- tokens served after an EOS are served past the stop, F-r17-14); LAG = the workload Program's declared static (R17-1), never read from the trace; positions >= executed_prefix_len are programmed-but-unexecuted (not required; committed = execution past the stop)
not_executed_by_rule.scope: NOT-EXECUTED-BY-RULE is an active-reference implementation classification only. In the lifted fixed Program the corresponding positions are REQUIRED logical values assigned the canonical inactive representation tau(e) = bot; there is no not-required-because-not-executed category. (COORD R17-27)

replay_cache.rule: coord M-0090 (5): C2 sampled replay once per distinct (run root, manifest digest, seed) per Commit stage; equal-root pairs reference that record
